name: General Post Office, Hong Kong
scope: Whole named1976 Hong Kong General Post Office: original13-vertex building envelope and9-vertex five-storey/6-vertex three-storey office components. Broad low white limestone-faced modernist block, flat roof/parapets, two upper office window rows with actual deep splayed white reveals, dark intermediate ribbon, tall public-hall window bays, projecting scalloped concrete canopy and open ground piloti, relatively solid east side/fins, lower rear wing and bounded small roof plant. POI polygon identifies office only. Exclude separate IFC/Jardine House, exterior banners/sign lettering/flags, connecting public walkways, street, construction site, people, vehicles, gardens and interiors.
era: Photographed surviving1976 GPO exterior in2024/2026 before planned Central harbourfront redevelopment. Government text identifies planned demolition, not completed removal. Exact October2026 condition/remaining operating functions and future redevelopment are not asserted; no1911 demolished predecessor or future Central Yards substitute.
